scope: Only NIST-available DOI sources occurring exclusively in original strict training. No strict validation/test numeric values determine source flags.
quarantine: All original strict-training records of a flagged DOI, with no value replacement. Original strict validation and global test records/queries/targets stay byte-identical.
split: Keep original743/93/144 scaffold roles; remove training identities only if no retained record; never rerandomize.
model_policy: Refit every affected strict model; same seeds/hyperparameters/budgets, same shared global final test. Main identity sourceqa bank and running job remain unchanged.
reason: Correct source-curation boundary, independently of model scores. Historical primary-audit inspection of strict development data is disclosed; no final-test target was inspected.
